text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from going out with Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Hey, hey!
Did you learn how to write Trainer's name!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could that be about that time you wrote 'Sunset' before?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was able to write it down, but in the end,
I still couldn't figure out what Twin Turbo was actually looking for.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, maybe it was because last time was what Turbo wanted to write! This time let's write what Trainer wants to write!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what about flowers?! Do you like flowers?
Turbo doesn't really know their names,
but I like 'em a lot!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's go then!
Turbo heard about a place with a ton of flowers in bloom!
Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How's that!! Full of flowers!
Flowers over here, flowers over there! Nothing but flowers!
choice_data_list: Are you going to write here?
Are you going to write here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing makes sense, but writing words...?
Puzzled, I asked her about it, bringing up what happened last time—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is different!!
Turbo can't wait for Trainer's 'flower'!
Since it's Trainer, maybe it'll be all smiley!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I'm getting so excited!!
Turbo's gonna go over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The topic is probably "flowers." That much is clear.
However...
After agonizing for a moment, she took out a pen and paper—
choice_data_list: I carefully wrote the character for 'flower'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to observe the flowers carefully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Different colors, and different sizes too.
Even if they're all simply called "flowers," their shapes are all different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The word "Flower" written on a sheet of white paper.
It's written in her usual, unremarkable handwriting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Something's off. That's what I think looking at my own handwriting.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Flowers, flowers, pretty flow-ers!
Good job blooming so nicely!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Purple, pink, white, so many!
They're all different, and all so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I understand somehow.
Though it's hard to put into words, what Twin Turbo
wanted to convey was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I agonized over it,
but I couldn't bring myself to rewrite it.
I simply didn't know how to put it into words.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you finish writing it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tell her that while vague ideas came to mind regarding what to write, I couldn't put them into proper shape.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then next time let's do something
with a bigger BOOM!
Something that really makes you go "Whoaaa!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then I bet I'll get to see Trainer's handwriting!
Turbo can't wait--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind a brightly smiling Twin Turbo,
the word "Flower" was written using
fallen petals of various colors gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I couldn't put it into words,
seeing that "flower" made me feel like
I'd grasped the answer I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to tell the difference,
I simply focus and write "Flower" with utmost care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wrote it neatly, but it just doesn't feel right.
I feel like this won't be enough to convince Twin Turbo either...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Are you done writing!?
Turbo finished writing hers!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, over there!
Over there, that's Turbo's "flower"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction pointed out,
there was the character for "Flower"
spelled out in colorful petals.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: How's that?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahem!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo always writes with such neat handwriting.
Even if she does get the kanji wrong quite often—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps the feelings poured into those characters conveyed their meaning more directly than anything else ever could.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Listen! Picking up flower petals was super fun too! Even if they're the same color, they're all a little different, so choosing them is a blast!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wanna pick some up too, Trainer?
There were tons over there, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled by the hand by Twin Turbo,
I went along to pick up flower petals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't put the shape of the answer into words,
but I felt like Twin Turbo had taught me
something important.
